rwanda.title: Flag of the Republic of Rwanda

colors.note: Symbolises economic development and mineral wealth.
Represents prosperity, work, and the country's natural resources.
The 24-ray sun stands for enlightenment, unity, and transparency in the fight against ignorance.

desc:
- Three horizontal bands of blue (double width), yellow, and green with a 24-ray golden sun at the upper fly
- Adopted on 25 October 2001 to replace the former red-yellow-green tricolour associated with the genocide
- Designed by artist Alphonse Kirimobenecyo to symbolise a new era of unity and hope
trivia:
- Rwanda deliberately avoided red in the new flag because of its association with the 1994 genocide
- The previous flag from 1962 was a vertical red-yellow-green tricolour with the letter R
- The 24-ray sun was added to symbolise enlightenment and the dawn of a new era
- Designer Alphonse Kirimobenecyo is also a poet and sculptor from Rwanda
